Consumer judgment validates all economic propositions through market exchange. Guidance selling introduces prescription alongside description, creating a distinct commodity with transaction friction. Expert swarming reflects the increasing division of labor in interpreting complex systems. Together, these operators form a unified framework where economic activity is fundamentally about managing uncertainty through specialized knowledge intermediaries. Failure occurs when market feedback breaks down, leading to bubbles, crashes, or policy failures.
